name: E1_straight
description: Analytical R = rho L/(w t) = 0.084 ohm at 300 K; L=100 µm, w=10 µm, t=2 µm.
title: Straight conductor
learning_goal: Compare the solved resistance with the uniform-strip analytical limit.
physical_scope: Uniform thickness copper sheet; the analytical comparison applies at fixed 300 K.

name: E2_bent_taper
description: Bent, tapered conductor; current crowding near the reentrant corner is mesh-sensitive.
title: Bent and tapered conductor
learning_goal: See how a taper and a reentrant corner redistribute current.
physical_scope: Ideal sharp corners have mesh-sensitive peak current density; refine before comparing peaks.

name: E3_parallel
description: Two parallel routes with 10 and 20 µm widths, including distributed access resistance.
title: Unequal parallel routes
learning_goal: Compare current sharing through unequal-width branches and common access buses.
physical_scope: Distributed access resistance is included, so branch sharing is not a simple width-only ratio.

name: E4_multilayer
description: Nonrectangular two-metal structure, finite copper via and separate layer potentials.
title: Two-metal transfer
learning_goal: Follow lateral transport through a nonrectangular second layer and a finite via.
physical_scope: Separate sheet potentials couple through a finite copper via; this is a 2.5D representation.

name: E5_via_array
description: Hierarchical 4 × 5 array of finite vias; nonuniform transfer current across a 200 µm pad.
title: Hierarchical via array
learning_goal: Inspect repeated layout instances and unequal transfer through a 4 × 5 via array.
physical_scope: Individual via footprints are resolved; through-thickness current is represented by interface links.

name: E6_kelvin
description: Four-terminal sheet/contact test; floating sense terminals draw exactly zero net current.
title: Kelvin sheet and contact test
learning_goal: Separate voltage sensing from current injection using zero-current floating electrodes.
physical_scope: Floating sense electrodes are equipotential constraints and can perturb the sheet locally.

name: E7_hemt
description: Illustrative depletion-mode interdigitated HEMT. Local gate control only under gate mask; access channel uses the configured ungated carrier-density cap. Field plate is insulated and has no electrostatic effect. Ungated channel edges permit bypass current. Metal/channel to substrate thermal links use an effective 2e-7 m²K/W for omitted buffer/dielectric paths; these parallel heat paths require process calibration. Not a calibrated transistor model.
title: Interdigitated HEMT
learning_goal: Explore local gate control, finite source/drain contacts, and thermal coupling.
physical_scope: Illustrative resistive 2DEG law, with ungated edge bypass; the insulated field plate has no electrostatic effect.

name: E8_hemt_routing
description: Illustrative depletion-mode interdigitated HEMT. Local gate control only under gate mask; access channel uses the configured ungated carrier-density cap. Field plate is insulated and has no electrostatic effect. Ungated channel edges permit bypass current. Metal/channel to substrate thermal links use an effective 2e-7 m²K/W for omitted buffer/dielectric paths; these parallel heat paths require process calibration. Not a calibrated transistor model.
title: HEMT with resistive routing
learning_goal: Compare thin access buses with the thicker routing in E7.
physical_scope: Same effective channel law as E7; metal thickness changes routing resistance, not transistor electrostatics.

name: E9_sic
description: Effective n=10^18 cm^-3, mobility=400 cm²/Vs at 300 K; resistive sheet, no junction physics.
title: Conducting SiC sheet
learning_goal: Connect carrier density and mobility to sheet conduction and contact loss.
physical_scope: Effective doped semiconductor resistor; no junction, depletion, or breakdown physics.

name: E10_thermal_stack
description: Thickness-averaged metal/oxide/silicon model. Bottom boundary includes half substrate thickness.
title: Metal–oxide–silicon stack
learning_goal: Resolve lateral heat spreading and the resistance of a layered thermal path.
physical_scope: Thickness-averaged layers; the bottom boundary includes half of the substrate thickness.

name: E11_serpentine_heater
description: Five-pass 8 µm wide, 0.25 µm thick platinum serpentine, driven at 20 mA. Square turns demonstrate current crowding; corner peaks require a mesh study. The explicit 260 × 152 µm silicon substrate extends beyond the imported conductor. A 2e-6 m²K/W effective dielectric link and a 2e6 W/m²K backside sink are illustrative; the omitted dielectric has no resolved lateral heat flow. An independent 2 mW heater load also makes thermal-only mode meaningful. Steady-state thickness-averaged model; no transient heat capacity, radiation or calibrated thin-film transport.
title: Serpentine thin-film heater
learning_goal: Inspect corner crowding, temperature feedback, and heat spreading beyond a five-pass trace.
physical_scope: Illustrative platinum film on silicon, with an effective thermal interface; sharp-corner peaks need mesh refinement.

name: E12_via_ladder
description: Three 1 µm copper levels form a U-shaped series route with two hierarchical 3 × 3 banks of 6 × 6 µm finite copper vias, 2 µm high. A 0.3 A terminal current must cross both banks; individual vias can carry different currents. Each metal has a separate potential and temperature. Effective 1e-6 m²K/W links to a larger silicon substrate approximate omitted dielectric paths; they are parallel thermal paths requiring process calibration. An independent 3 mW load is applied to the middle riser. Vias are distributed interlayer conductances, not resolved 3D solids. The via-height sweep changes electrical resistance only; thermal via conductance is independently fixed.
title: Three-level via ladder
learning_goal: Follow sequential vertical transfer through two hierarchical 3 × 3 via banks.
physical_scope: Three independent sheet potentials linked by finite copper vias; no full 3D via-sidewall field solution.

name: E13_perforated_spreader
description: A 240 × 140 µm, 2 µm thick copper sheet contains three staggered 10 × 92 µm slots and two diamond cutouts. These are actual holes in the conductor, not decorative masks. A 0.75 A edge drive diverts current around slot ends; a separate 6 mW localized load exercises thermal-only mode. The continuous, larger SiC substrate remains beneath the copper holes. Its effective interface resistance is 5e-7 m²K/W and backside sink is 2e6 W/m²K. Sharp-corner current peaks are mesh-dependent; use spatial averages or a refinement study. This steady-state sheet approximation omits 3D sidewall spreading and mechanical stress.
title: Perforated current spreader
learning_goal: See current diversion around staggered slots and diamond holes in a conducting sheet.
physical_scope: True void topology is preserved in the mesh; ideal hole corners produce mesh-sensitive current peaks.

name: E14_bridge_sensor
description: Four-arm Wheatstone bridge: three 100 Ω/□ TaN sheets and one 110 Ω/□ sensing arm. The 0.1 V drive uses finite-conductivity metal buses and ideal arm/pad interfaces. Floating midpoint electrodes draw zero net current. Read V(sense_top) − V(sense_bottom); effective resistance instead reports the source/drain drive resistance. Sweep the lower-right sheet resistance through 100 Ω/□ to reverse the differential output. A separate 0.2 mW prescribed sensor load also makes thermal-only operation meaningful; fixed sheet resistance does not model thermoresistive transduction. Synthetic 2.5D demonstration, not a calibrated sensor.
title: Four-arm resistive bridge
learning_goal: Read a differential bridge imbalance with separate current drive and floating midpoint probes.
physical_scope: Four effective sheet resistors and metal pads; resistor mismatch represents a sensor response without a mechanical model.

name: E15_thermal_crosstalk
description: Two electrically independent three-pass TiN heaters share a larger silicon thermal layer. A and B are biased at 0.4 V and 0.25 V; prescribed loads add 0.5 mW and 0.15 mW respectively. Electrical mode computes each powered net; reported resistance uses A only. Thermal-only mode uses prescribed loads without Joule heating, whereas electrothermal mode adds both Joule loads. Sweep load_a with B held fixed and inspect the rise of B temperature to observe thermal crosstalk. Effective 2e-6 m²K/W interfaces represent omitted isolation stacks; the 5e4 W/m²K backside sink and representative film properties need calibration. Synthetic steady-state 2.5D example.
title: Dual-heater thermal crosstalk
learning_goal: Inspect overlapping temperature fields from independently driven meanders on a shared substrate.
physical_scope: Effective sheet-to-substrate heat transfer; prescribed sources also permit a meaningful independent thermal solve.

name: E16_full_gate_hemt_array
description: Four separated parallel GaN 2DEG stripes join shared source/drain metal buses through finite 1e-10 Ωm² contacts, with 0.1 V drain bias. One gate bar spans each complete channel width, so every source-to-drain channel path crosses a controlled region; there is no ungated edge bypass. The gold gate is electrically insulated and modeled as a thermal-only layer; its voltage enters the local analytical charge-control model through gate_control. No gate leakage, capacitance, electrostatic field solution, velocity saturation or calibrated transistor prediction is provided. A 1e-7 S sheet-conductance floor limits deep-off current and maintains numerical conditioning; the off-state current is not a leakage prediction. A 0.2 mW prescribed channel load supports thermal-only operation and adds to Joule heating in coupled mode. Effective thermal interfaces represent omitted buffer/dielectric paths.
title: Full-width gated HEMT array
learning_goal: Contrast E7's edge bypass with gate control that spans every channel in a four-channel array.
physical_scope: Resistive 2DEG approximation with finite contacts; no velocity saturation, gate leakage, trapping, or electrostatic field-plate model.

name: E17_pulsed_thermal
description: Uniform prescribed heat pulses in a 100 × 100 × 10 µm copper plate, with h=1e5 W/(m² K). Thermal-only operation excludes Joule heating. The spatially uniform limit has tau=rho*cp*t/h and high-level steady rise=10 K, so the transient can be checked against a lumped RC. Pulse width is the 200 µs plateau, period 700 µs, and delay 100 µs. Reduce dt to check time accuracy.
title: Pulsed heating and cooling
learning_goal: Compare pulse heating and cooling with the uniform lumped thermal RC limit, then refine the time step.
physical_scope: Prescribed heat drives uniform copper thermal storage; electrical Joule heating is excluded. Pulse width means high plateau.

name: E18_pulsed_conductor
description: Pulsed 100 × 10 × 2 µm copper conductor with quasi-static current and temperature-dependent resistivity. The 0.25 A pulse has 10 µs rise, 60 µs high plateau and 10 µs fall, repeated every 200 µs after a 25 µs delay. Finite edge times need time-step refinement. Heat capacity and cooling produce delayed thermal response; electrical capacitance and inductance are not included.
title: Pulsed electrothermal conductor
learning_goal: Follow current pulses, Joule energy, delayed temperature peaks and cooling with temperature feedback.
physical_scope: Backward Euler thermal storage with quasi-static electrical feedback; no electrical capacitance, inductance or switching losses.

name: E19_pulsed_multilayer
description: A 10 mW, 100 µs single pulse heats a 30 × 30 × 5 µm copper island. An unpowered 30 × 30 × 10 µm copper receiver sits 20 µm away on the same 20 µm silicon substrate. Finite interface conductances create separate layer temperatures; receiver heating and its delayed peak arise entirely from thermal crosstalk. Inspect heater, substrate and receiver histories. Prescribed heat only; no electrical solve. Input energy is 1 µJ. Thickness-averaged sheets and representative materials require process calibration.
title: Multilayer pulse and thermal crosstalk
learning_goal: Compare heater, substrate and unpowered receiver histories to locate the delayed crosstalk peak.
physical_scope: A prescribed single heat pulse transfers through finite interfaces and a shared silicon sheet; no electrical drive or through-thickness diffusion.

name: E20_high_current_rdl
description:
Synthetic copper DC RDL with geometric vias; no semiconductor, EM or switching prediction.
1000 × 1000 µm; requested 10 A; reference/uniform_single/attached.
Inputs are synthetic engineering assumptions at 300 K, not calibrated ratings. One backside reservoir follows layer/interface thermal paths; effective thickness averaging omits depth-resolved gradients. External feed loss is deposited 25% in the landing and 75% outside the model. Detailed individual via/load currents, group currents/active width or area, local source potentials and the disjoint loss ledger are available in Results.
